summary: Tested MeetingLocationPicker integration into MOM dialog for offline meetings. Verified: 1) Consulting Meetings page loads correctly with 23 scheduled, 10 MOM submitted, 8 sent to client, 2) Backend PATCH /meetings/{id}/mom endpoint correctly handles travel_details and creates expense records, 3) Travel expense calculation works correctly (Rs.7/km for Car, Rs.3/km for Bike), 4) Expense is linked to meeting after MOM save, 5) Expense approval workflow creates notifications.

integration_issues.issue: MOM dialog only opens for meetings with 'CONDUCTED' status. For 'Awaiting MOM' meetings, clicking MOM button shows a tooltip 'MOM not yet recorded. Meeting details are available after MOM is submitted.' This is expected behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: MeetingLocationPicker component IS integrated at ConsultingMeetings.js lines 2305-2334
Integration is conditional: only shows for selectedMeeting?.mode === 'offline'
Backend MOM endpoint correctly extracts travel_details and creates expense in background task (lines 739-847)
seed_data_creation: Created test expense via MOM save for meeting d9924f63-920e-47e7-be5e-f81770d6aab0 (Rs.2100, 150km round trip by Car)
context_for_next_testing_agent: MeetingLocationPicker is integrated into MOM dialog for offline meetings. The component shows Travel & Conveyance section with SSOT badge, location inputs with Google Places autocomplete, travel mode buttons (Car/Bike/Transit/Accompanied), and distance calculation. Backend creates expense automatically when MOM is saved with travel_details. The MOM dialog only opens for meetings that have been 'CONDUCTED' - meetings with 'Awaiting MOM' status show a tooltip instead.
verified_features: MOM dialog opens for conducted meetings
Expense creation after MOM save with travel_details
